description: Screenshot of Q drop #2003 (board post No. 2799288, Aug 30 2018) rendered in an aggregator style. The drop links to a Donald Trump tweet URL and poses a series of questions about Nellie Ohr's fluency in Russian, ending with a reference to 'The FARM' (slang for CIA training). The drop's questions are its own claims.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI ID: e7ed77 No.2799288. 2003. Aug 30 2018 11:59:17 (EST). https://twitter.com/realDonaldTrump/status/1035148684432953346. Everything stated has meaning. What is the significance of Nellie Ohr being fluent in Russian? Is Russian a common language to learn? Why might this language be studied? What position might this language be useful? The FARM requires select skill-sets. Q
flags: Q-drop insinuations about Nellie Ohr are the drop's claims, unverified
